derivation_note: name/description/target_buyer are taken from the approved file. target_company_characteristics, trigger_patterns, problem_patterns, evidence_requirements and hook_style are structured restatements of the approved wording for matching - they add no prices, durations, case studies, guarantees or free offers (the approved file lists those as unconfirmed).

company.name: TechnoTribes
company.description: We help businesses work out where AI genuinely helps, then build it and take it into real production workflows.

global_constraints: Never mention case studies, client names or results (none are approved).
Never promise durations for audits or automation projects (unconfirmed).
Never offer free teardowns or free demo agents (unconfirmed).
Only recommend one of the offers below; never invent a service.

offers.name: AI Hiring - Rekroots
offers.description: AI-led hiring with Rekroots: a job board plus AI-led interviews that helps move from an open role toward a shortlist with less manual screening and scheduling.
offers.target_buyer: Founders, HR or talent leaders at companies with open roles to fill.
trigger_patterns: new office or plant needing staff
problem_patterns: slow time from open role to shortlist
constraints: Only when there is evidence of hiring or team growth.
evidence_requirements: at least one recent hiring or team-growth event about the company
offers.hook_style: Reference the specific hiring/growth event; offer a faster path from open role to shortlist.

offers.name: AI for NBFCs - AI Audit
offers.description: A paid AI audit for regulated financial-services organizations: identifies AI opportunities ranked by payoff and effort, considers compliance gates such as RBI and DPDP, and identifies where AI should not be used.
offers.target_buyer: Leaders at NBFCs and other regulated financial-services organizations exploring AI.
trigger_patterns: AI interest in a regulated finance context
problem_patterns: unclear where AI is safe under RBI / DPDP rules
many possible AI use cases without prioritisation
constraints: Only for regulated financial-services organizations (NBFC / lender / financier).
It is a paid engagement - do not imply otherwise.
evidence_requirements: evidence that the company is or operates as a regulated financial-services business
offers.hook_style: Compliance-aware: prioritised AI opportunities that respect RBI/DPDP gates.

offers.name: Enterprise AI Implementation
offers.description: Takes AI projects from stalled pilots or prototypes toward real production workflows, starting with a focused, paid two-week pilot on one real workflow measured against a business metric the client selects.
offers.target_buyer: Teams whose AI pilots or prototypes have stalled before reaching production.
constraints: Requires evidence of existing AI work or AI adoption intent.
Starts with a focused paid two-week pilot on one workflow.
evidence_requirements: evidence of AI interest, an AI pilot or AI adoption
offers.hook_style: Production-focused: one real workflow, measured against a metric they choose.

offers.name: 30-Day Prototype
offers.description: A production-oriented prototype (real code, not a mockup) for teams that know what they want to build but need development capacity; the client owns the code.
offers.target_buyer: Founders or product leaders who know what they want to build but lack development capacity.
constraints: Do not promise a fixed timeline beyond the offer name.
evidence_requirements: evidence of a product/platform being built or launched, or funding raised to build
offers.hook_style: Capacity-focused: real production-oriented code they own.

offers.name: AI Presales Agents
offers.description: AI agents for early sales and presales conversations: answer common questions, qualify leads, use the company's own documentation and support the booking/handoff process, reducing repetitive early-funnel questions for sales reps.
offers.target_buyer: Sales or revenue leaders whose reps handle repetitive early-funnel questions.
trigger_patterns: new product launches to many buyers
problem_patterns: reps answering the same early-funnel questions
evidence_requirements: evidence of customer acquisition, partnerships or sales growth
offers.hook_style: Sales-capacity: let an agent handle repetitive early questions and qualification.

offers.name: Healthcare AI Workflows
offers.description: AI audit and workflow services for healthcare organizations that handle patient data, emphasising patient-data risk, consent and DPDP requirements, identifying AI opportunities and where AI should and should not be used.
offers.target_buyer: Leaders at healthcare organizations handling patient data.
target_company_characteristics: clinics, hospitals or health-tech handling patient data
problem_patterns: unclear safe AI use in care workflows
constraints: Only for healthcare organizations that handle patient data.
evidence_requirements: evidence that the company is a healthcare organization handling patient data
offers.hook_style: Risk-aware: AI opportunities that respect patient-data consent and DPDP.

offers.name: Partner Model for Agencies
offers.description: A white-label AI development partnership for agencies whose clients ask for AI work: we act as the AI build team behind the agency's client work (white-label AI products and MVPs) on a paid, pilot-first model.
offers.target_buyer: Agency founders or delivery heads whose clients ask for AI work.
target_company_characteristics: digital, marketing, software or design agency
problem_patterns: AI requests from clients the agency cannot deliver
evidence_requirements: evidence that the company is an agency serving clients
offers.hook_style: Partner-focused: be the white-label AI build team behind their client work.

offers.name: AI Automation
offers.description: Automation of repetitive operational workflows (e.g. chasing documents, answering repetitive customer questions, moving data between systems, repetitive admin work), one workflow at a time, using the client's existing tools.
offers.target_buyer: Operations leaders or founders of teams losing time to repetitive work.
evidence_requirements: evidence of operational scale-up or repetitive operational work
offers.hook_style: Operations-focused: automate one repetitive workflow with the tools they already use.

offers.name: General AI Audit
offers.description: A general AI audit for businesses that want to know where AI is useful and what to implement first: top AI opportunities ranked by payoff, effort estimates, where AI should not be used and an implementation sequence.
offers.target_buyer: Founders or leaders unsure where AI would help or what to do first.
trigger_patterns: growth or funding without a clear AI plan
problem_patterns: risk of using AI where it should not be used
constraints: Default when evidence supports AI value but no specific offer fits better.
evidence_requirements: evidence of a qualifying business trigger (funding, growth or AI interest)
offers.hook_style: Clarity-focused: where AI pays off first, and where it should not be used.
